snippet.title: Whack Your Computer 15 Preview
snippet.description: NEW! On Google Play and soon in the Apple App store.  Enjoy this updated version of the classic game now with 15 ways to vent your frustration!  Dont' whack your computer .... WHACK YOUR COMPUTER!
